summary: First post-clone backend smoke test of RealTraffic. 18 endpoints across health, auth, admin, branding, AI/notification settings, sub-users, form-filler, real-user-traffic and CPI modules — all PASS. No 5xx anywhere. Admin login (admin@realtraffic.local/admin123) returns valid JWT with is_admin=true. New user registration → login → /api/auth/me round trip works. Admin endpoints (/users, /stats, /system-check, /ua-versions) all 200. CPI module mounted correctly under /api/cpi (offers + dashboard/stats both 200 for admin). Real-user-traffic engine-status and jobs list respond 200 for fresh user. App is in 'same working position' as expected post-clone — safe baseline for user to push their own changes.

minor.issue: Not under /api prefix so the Kubernetes ingress routes the external URL to the React frontend (returns index.html). Only reachable internally on http://localhost:8001/health. Either move it to /api/health or add an ingress rule. Internal probe confirms mongo_connected=true.

Returns dict {"jobs": [...]} while most other list endpoints return a bare JSON array (e.g. /api/sub-users, /api/cpi/offers, /api/admin/users). Inconsistent response shape — frontend has to special-case this one.
Pydantic field is `name`, not `full_name` as the test_credentials.md / endpoint convention might suggest. 422 if you send full_name. Worth documenting in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Move /health to /api/health so it's reachable through the public ingress, or add it to the ingress allowlist — useful for external uptime probes.
(Optional) Normalize /api/form-filler/jobs response shape to a bare list for consistency with the rest of the list endpoints, OR document it as a known dict shape in the API contract.
(Cosmetic) Pin bcrypt version compatible with passlib to silence the 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' WARNING that floods backend logs on each hash op. Auth still works — just noise.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is ~11.7k lines (line count near 11800 with /api routes mounted at line 11776 and CPI at 11793). FAR exceeds the 700-line soft limit — splitting into routers (auth, admin, uploads, real_user_traffic, form_filler, branding) is overdue for any future maintenance. This was already flagged in iteration_2 — still applies.

Health endpoint route is at line 262 of server.py and is registered on the bare `app` (not `api_router`), so it bypasses the /api prefix. This is the root cause of it not being reachable through the ingress.
passlib + bcrypt version skew warning continues to print on every password hash/verify (admin login emits 1 traceback per call). Non-blocking, but pollutes logs; pin `bcrypt<4.1` or upgrade passlib.
Code paths gracefully return 200 with empty/null payloads for users that don't have feature flags (form_filler/RUT/CPI) — good UX, no spurious 403s.

rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — this was a verification run after a git clone. Everything works as expected post-clone. The 3 minor findings (/health off /api, form-filler dict shape, register field name) are pre-existing API ergonomics issues, not regressions.
